 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u059/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4167a81c.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Draw a vertical stack above each 2/8 in the single nonzero row.

    Color 2 stacks are four cells tall; color 8 stacks are three cells tall.
    The top cell repeats the marker color and cells below it are 1s.
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    for c, color in enumerate(grid[base]):
        height = {2: 4, 8: 3}.get(color, 0)
        for offset in range(1, height + 1):
            r = base - offset
            if r < 0:
                break
            out[r][c] = color if offset == height else 1
    return out
